edits.old: If insertion or modification is unavailable, check whether Compass is operating read-only and whether the database user has write access. MongoDB describes combining database read privileges with Compass's readOnly setting for read-only use. (medium confidence)
edits.new: Compass's readOnly option prevents users from modifying documents, creating indexes, or specifying validation rules, and inserting documents is not permitted in Compass Readonly Edition. MongoDB describes replicating read-only behavior in a standard Compass edition by assigning users the read role at the database level and enabling the readOnly option. The readOnly option only hides write UI elements; database-level read-only enforcement requires the built-in read role. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/documents/insert.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/settings/read-only.md

evidence.quote: To replicate the read-only behavior in a standard Compass edition, assign users [`read`](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/built-in-roles.md#mongodb-authrole-read) access at the database level and enable the [readOnly](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/settings/read-only.md#std-label-compass-read-only) option in Compass.
Inserting documents is not permitted in MongoDB Compass Readonly Edition.
If you enable the `readOnly` option, users cannot modify documents, create indexes, or specify validation rules.
The `readOnly` option does not fully disable write operations. Instead, it hides the UI elements that conduct write operations.

statements.statement: If insertion or modification is unavailable, check whether Compass is operating read-only and whether the database user has write access.
statements.note: Sources confirm readOnly mode/Readonly Edition blocks insert and modify; the docs give no troubleshooting checklist, and database-level restriction comes from the read role. Advice is a reasonable inference but not stated.

statements.statement: MongoDB describes combining database read privileges with Compass's readOnly setting for read-only use.
statements.note: Stated on the insert, settings and read-only pages.

edits.rationale: The MongoDB docs confirm that readOnly mode (or Readonly Edition) blocks insertion and modification, and that the documented read-only recipe combines the database-level read role with Compass's readOnly option. The docs contain no troubleshooting guidance telling users to check for these when writes are unavailable, so that framing is an inference rather than a documented statement. The read-only page also warns that readOnly only hides write UI, while the read role enforces restriction at the database level.
